summary: Two flush Collapsibles inside a padded side panel: no box, title and body aligned to the panel gutter, a hairline between sections.
use: Sections inside a surface that already has its own background, border and padding, such as a context side panel.
spec: `<Collapsible title="Deal" variant="flush" divided open>` draws a top border
